Training days weekday rules
This part of the manual explains one way of working
Companion Animal Travel Desk

Purpose: This section sets the standard approach for weekday desk work, from first contact to handover.

Staff at Aurelia Skyways keep a steady, practical manner when handling companion animal bookings and follow-up. The Companion Animal Travel Desk opens each case with a clear record, checks the travel need, and keeps the notes in order so the next team member can pick up the file without delay. Questions from travelers are met in a warm professional tone, and staff give plain instructions that match the trip and the animal's needs. If the traveler is unsure about forms, crate checks, or cabin and hold arrangements, the desk explains the process in simple terms and records any agreed action in the file.

The desk keeps the same standard for every stage of service. Information gathered at booking stays with the case through preparation, airport contact, and pickup. When a traveler changes details, staff update the record at once and share the new instructions with the crew or ground team as needed. The desk does not guess at missing details, and it does not leave unanswered notes in circulation. If a pet shows special handling needs, the record must state the issue plainly and flag it for review by the senior coordinator.

Careful wording matters in all replies, both spoken and written. Staff avoid rushed language, keep the tone calm, and use the same terms for the same task across the desk. Records must remain neat, complete, and easy to read, since they guide later action and protect the traveler and the animal. When the case closes, the final note should show what was done and what remains for any later contact.

For uncertain cases or service issues, contact the senior coordinator on duty.
